decision: Phase 1 starts with a saved baseline of all 7 patients
why: Fixes are judged as before vs after on the same cases

decision: Repo renamed to artemis-hiv
why: User's pick from four free names

decision: chromadb 1.5.9 advisories (PYSEC-2026-311, -3813, -3814, -3815) not fixed yet
why: No fixed version exists; all four need Chroma's HTTP server, and the app uses the embedded PersistentClient with no server
result: Owner accepted for now (2026-11-18); ignored in CI by ID, revisit in Phase 2B or when a fix ships

decision: RAG revamp added as Phase 2B, measured on the evaluation cases
why: Owner: old retrieval was inconsistent and hard to diagnose; wants to learn current RAG methods

decision: Model auto-pick only when the server lists exactly one model
why: OpenRouter lists hundreds, so taking the first would be arbitrary and billed

decision: Fixed the 5 failing tests by updating the tests, not the code
why: Both breaks were deliberate code changes the tests never caught up with: the patient name field was removed in 8b19fb8, and citations stopped showing chunk ids in 306ef45
evidence: git show 8b19fb8 306ef45; pytest before: 5 failed, 11 passed

decision: pytest collects only tests/ (pytest.ini testpaths); the three top-level debugging scripts deleted (owner, 2026-11-25)
why: They were February debugging scripts that wrote dbg.txt files on import, one to a hardcoded Desktop path; git history keeps them
evidence: dbg.txt appeared in the repo and on the Desktop after a full pytest run
result: Full run 100 s to 26 s; no stray files

decision: Tests run on GitHub on every push and pull request (tests.yml), CPU torch
why: A red check before merge; the default Linux torch pulls about 3 GB of GPU libraries the tests never use
result: Passed on PR #2 and on development, 2026-11-25

decision: Packages locked with pip-tools: requirements.in (11 direct) compiled to requirements.txt (133 pinned, setuptools included)
why: Owner's pick over hand-pinning 11 packages: unpinned sub-packages could turn the test check red with no change of ours. Seeded with the versions already tested. No hashes, because the CPU torch build and the PyPI torch build have different hashes
evidence: Linux install dry run from the lock: 133 packages, all pinned, torch resolves to the CPU build
result: Fresh install from the lock: no broken requirements, 16 passed, pip-audit clean apart from the 4 accepted chromadb advisories. All 8 GitHub checks passed on PR #3

decision: No pull requests into development or staging: merge locally and push after a yes; a pull request only for staging into main
why: Owner: clicking through pull requests on GitHub costs too much of their spare time; their rules require a pull request only for main

decision: Plan item 0.6 (where guideline files live) moved to Phase 2B as 2B.6
why: Owner's pick: 2B decides which documents are searched and how their text is extracted, so settling storage first risks doing it twice
evidence: The app searches 4 Markdown files; the 3 PDFs in Data/ (28 MB) are unused except by one test (app.py:63-82, tests/test_guideline_processor.py)

decision: Baseline runs each patient 3 times through app._run_analysis itself, with Streamlit stubbed
why: Calling the real function means a rerun after a fix shows that fix; temperature 0.2 makes answers vary, so one run per patient can't separate a fix from noise

decision: Fix 1 (G01): deleted the unreachable AI modes (checklist, per-alert explanations, synthesis, narrative), the page-range filter, the switched-off plan renderer and an unused helper
why: Owner's pick (option A). The owner removed these modes from the menu on 2026-02-05 (commit 0b7c225); their code still held copies of live faults, so later fixes would have had to be made twice
evidence: git history keeps the code; S5-17 moved to G10 (a real fault, not dead code)
result: Golden pipeline check unchanged for all 7 patients; 30 tests pass

decision: Fix 2 (G02, G03): clear the results when the clinician switches patients; reopening a patient's last results waits for the saved visit record (fix 9b)
why: Owner's pick (option A), with B (remember per patient, saving AI round trips) wanted later
result: Done: switching to P002 no longer shows P001's alert; an edited note shows a 'note has changed' warning; the add-case form clears and selects the new case

decision: Code moves into its new folder layout (artemis/ logic, ui/streamlit screen, later api/ and web/) piece by piece, as each fix touches it
why: Owner's pick (option A): no big-bang restructure; each move is protected by the golden pipeline check

decision: Fix 3 (G04, G05): rule alerts always shown next to AI alerts, each tagged 'Rule check' or 'AI review'; a failed or unreadable AI review shows an amber 'AI review failed' banner, is never GREEN, and still allows Finalize
why: Owner's picks (one tagged list; amber banner with finalize allowed). Rule alerts vanished whenever the AI answered; an unreadable reply or server failure showed GREEN
evidence: tests/test_visit_alerts.py, tests/test_results_banner.py; eval/fixes/fix3-before.txt, fix3-after.txt; golden diff: P001 +1 rule alert, P003 +2, nothing else changed
result: Done. modules/analysis.py moved to artemis/visit.py (first file in the new layout)

decision: Start docs/lessons-learned.md: one entry per new kind of silent failure, with the real example and how it was caught
why: Owner: worth sharing what AI-assisted clinical code gets wrong (not as a paper)

decision: Fix 4 (G06, G07, G08): every lab result has one shape (value as typed, unit, date, source); the model reads a dated lab table with each result's age in days and dated, labelled notes with today's note marked; the add-case form takes one row per result in two tables; Patient Details shows structured results
why: Owner's picks: one row per result with the usual unit when blank (a creatinine under 20 in umol/L is refused as likely mg/dL); the visit date stored with the case, with the app working out each lab's age. Before: P001-P004 were told 'Laboratory results: None recorded', P001's 113-day viral load was called over 6 months old, and creatinine typed in mg/dL was saved as umol/L
evidence: tests/test_lab_input.py (9), tests/test_ui_labs.py (2); eval/fixes/fix4-before.txt, fix4-after.txt; browser check in Chrome; golden diff: only the screening model input changed
result: Done. patient_parser and stage1_summary moved to artemis/patient/ first, with no behaviour change

decision: Fix 5 (G09, G12): drugs are recognised however the regimen was written (codes, names, combinations like TLD); the rules read the medicine list and pasted lab text, skip negated mentions, and a creatinine only in pasted text is reported as such, not as missing; the add-case regimen is a pick-list; the 3 old cases were converted once
why: Owner's picks: pick-list (A); convert the 3 old cases now, keeping the text as written, lab text left as text (A). Before: P005 (on TLD, eGFR 52, ibuprofen, protein 1+) got no rule alerts at all because her regimen was a sentence
evidence: tests/test_medicines_and_rules.py (9); tests/test_screen_patient_switch.py; scripts/convert_old_cases.py (run twice, second run changed nothing); eval/fixes/fix5-before.txt, fix5-after.txt; golden diff: P005 +3 rule alerts, P006 and Kintu +1 each, P003 same alert with narrower evidence, P001/P002/P004 unchanged
result: Done. Data/custom_patients.json converted (regimens to codes with art_regimen_as_entered kept; 'None' medicine entries removed; P005's previous regimen moved from Other Medications to her history, marked). modules/alert_rules.py moved to artemis/rules/checks.py first

decision: Fix 6 (G10, G11): the summary the AI reads lists what is recorded (regimen, other medicines, complaints, examination, today's assessment and plan, orders, medicine changes, labs) and names only truly empty fields under not_recorded; the whole Assessment & Plan box is today's plan, labelled so in the AI's input
why: Owner's pick: the whole box (A), separate plan fields in the Phase 3 design. Before: every patient was told 'other medications: missing' (wrong key) and 'today's plan: missing' (only lines starting 'Plan:' counted)
evidence: tests/test_summary_facts.py (5), tests/test_stage1_summary.py rewritten (it asserted the old guesses); eval/fixes/fix6-before.txt, fix6-after.txt; golden diff: only the screening model input changed
result: Done. S5-17 (the AI plan never reads the summary) moved to fix 7, which rewrites the plan's input

decision: Fix 7 (G13, G14, G15, G25, S5-17): the plan prompt asks for a verdict on every item and allows Uncertain; the screen shows 'Not assessed' for a missing verdict, 'No plan to compare' when the clinician wrote none, a grey 'Needs review' for an unclear regimen decision, and a warning on plans that failed the checks; the verification step is deleted; the plan step reads the fix 6 summary and dated notes, without the patient's name
why: Owner's picks for all four. Before: 36 of 44 items showed 'Matches your plan' with no verdict (22 for patients with no plan), P004's 'Uncertain' showed as green Continue in 3 of 3 runs, 17 of 21 plans failed the checks and were shown without warning, and the patient's name was sent to the AI (P004's plan named her)
evidence: tests/test_plan_view.py (9); eval/fixes/fix7-before.txt, fix7-after.txt; real runs: P002 verdicts Gap/Not Addressed, checks passed; P005 Uncertain shown as Needs review, No plan to compare
result: Done. Plan reading moved to artemis/plan/plan_json.py and artemis/plan/view.py (one copy, was two); plan output limit raised from 400 to 1000 tokens

decision: Fix 8 (G18, G19, G20, G21, G22): the reply reader finds the alert list past bracketed words, accepts a single alert, treats plain sentences as unreadable, and keeps the complete alerts from a cut-off reply; cut-off and partly read replies get an amber banner and are never GREEN; the clients report why a reply ended; the 4B-era clean-up is deleted and only exact repeats are dropped; severity is one of four or 'not given' (amber); citations are marked shown_to_ai; an AI alert's References are only the passages it was shown and cited, a rule alert's are labelled as search results
why: Owner's picks for all three. Before (audit, measured): a reply starting 'Based on the guideline excerpts [1]' gave 0 alerts and parsed_empty; a cut-off reply lost every alert; 'Missing hepatitis B test' was dropped as a copy of 'Missing creatinine test'; a high viral-load alert was merged into a moderate creatinine one; 'Hb 9.1 then 7.2' lost the 7.2; 273 of 335 listed References were never shown to the AI
evidence: tests/test_ai_replies.py (17), test_results_banner.py (+2), test_ui_references.py (3), test_screen_ai_alert.py (1); eval/fixes/fix8-before.txt, fix8-after.txt; real run, 7 patients once: all replies read in full, finish 'stop', format accepted, 15 of 18 citations to passages shown
result: Done. Golden: alerts, messages, severities and colours unchanged for all 7; citations marked and AI alerts' passages now the cited ones. Logged for Phase 2: the model cites a placeholder 'information_gap' passage instead of none (P006, 3 citations)

decision: Fix 9 picks (D11 follow-up): the visit record is saved when the checks run and again at Finalize; it is one plain-text file per patient (JSON Lines, one line per event, only ever added to) in a folder git ignores; coming back to a patient shows a 'Show last saved results' button instead of the results appearing on their own
why: Owner's picks. Saving at both points keeps checks that were run but never reviewed and lets 9b bring results back without a new AI call; a text file is the simplest store until the real database; results appearing on their own could be taken for today's (the fix 2 mix-up). evidence: eval/fixes/fix9-before.txt: Finalize allowed 'Other' with no comment, wrote nothing, and a reload lost everything
result: Plan: 4.5 moves the records into Postgres; open decision 2 updated

why: Owner's picks (see the fix 9 picks row). Before: Finalize allowed 'Other' with no comment, wrote nothing, and a reload lost everything
